description: This PHP class defines the MyLeaveListController in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin, extending LeaveListController. It manages preparing the leave list component for rendering, configuring leave statuses, types, and date filters.

classes.name: MyLeaveListController
classes.description: Controller managing the leave list view for the current user, setting up the Vue component with necessary data and properties.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the leave list component with required props before rendering, including statuses, types, and date filters.
